svg.title: Eval results on a small open model, gpt-oss-20b: Held-out tests: 93% with Juggle vs 76% with no skill; Development tests: 92% with Juggle vs 77% with no skill; Layering checks, held-out: 95% with Juggle vs 78% with no skill; Layering checks, development: 95% with Juggle vs 82% with no skill.
